title: Bitwise AggregateFunction leaf admission through existing recursive storage codecs and consumers

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the finite declared target
claim.meaning: Curated index to root-observed commands, source and actual captures; filled fields or correlated model agreement are not proof.

risk.boundary: Nominal/wire aggregate-state admission and persistent fixed-width state defaults
risk.rollback: One exact-path atomic local feature commit; no push, dependency change or history rewrite.

admitted.state_law: One raw dispatched integer word; OR/XOR default all zero, AND default all FF; immutable nominally typed state.
admitted.recursion: Existing value/bulk/physical/Wide/table/offline owners are reused; no per-product container codec or contextual guard relaxation.
admitted.native_target: Wide/LZ4/Default/plain-mrk2/with_size_stream; 36 root states and Array(Tuple(or_u16 AF(groupBitOr,UInt16),and_i128 AF(groupBitAnd,Int128),xor_u256 AF(groupBitXor,UInt256))).
admitted.endianness: Pinned little-endian source/runtime qualification, not a cross-endian protocol promise.

local_refusals: Bitwise Nullable/LowCardinality argument shells and non-bare-integer leaves
Nonzero versions, parameters, non-unary shapes, aliases/families/combinators
Count-only accessors on non-Count states and existing state-envelope/Map-key exclusions

reused_without_edit: WidePartColumn and static Wide reader/writer/public consumers

laws: AggregateFunctionBitwise.cpp:41-103,262-269,343-359; Helpers.h:91-123: exact unary integer factory, zero/FF defaults, raw word serialization.
ExpressionElementParsers.cpp:1507-1565: unquoted wide number parsing can fall back to Float64; fixture CAST operands use quoted exact decimal strings.

SerializationObjectSharedData.cpp:375-391: fresh nested Advanced Data tapes force Dynamic/Object V3 with statistics NONE; legacy statistics-free inline guard removal does not widen current persisted compatibility.
reference_source.provenance: Fresh comparison source and pinned executed runtime are distinct identities; original archive remains untouched.
